options.why_wrong: This uses the present simple, which does not match the past time frame set by the stem.

options.why_wrong: 'While' with an action in progress needs the past continuous ('was playing'), not the simple past.
This uses the past perfect for a finished event, so it does not fit an action in progress after 'while'.

explanation: The stem sets an action in progress in the past, so the second clause must also describe an action in progress at the same time, using the past continuous. Speakers whose first language marks ongoing past actions differently may be tempted to use the simple past here.
translation: Mientras ella estudiaba, su hermano tocaba la guitarra en la habitación de al lado.
